name: Discourage Search Engines Notifier
author: MΛCHINΣ CØDΣ

sections.description:
Discourage Search Engines Notifier adds a clear red or green eye icon to your WordPress admin bar, instantly indicating whether your site is hidden from search engines. Clicking the icon takes you directly to the Search Engine Visibility settings page. No setup or configuration is required—simply install and activate the plugin.

Key Features

  • Red/green eye icon indicating search engine visibility
  • Direct access to the Search Engine Visibility settings
  • Works out of the box with no configuration required
  • Lightweight and efficient, with minimal impact on performance
  • Supports donations via Ko-fi and Buy Me a Coffee

sections.installation:
• Download the plugin and upload it to /wp-content/plugins/ or use the WordPress plugin uploader
  • Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  • The eye icon will appear in the WordPress admin bar
sections.faq:
• What does the plugin do? Displays a red or green eye icon in the admin bar to monitor your site’s search engine visibility.
  • How do I use it? Click the icon to go directly to the Search Engine Visibility settings page.
  • Does it require any configuration? No, it works immediately after activation.
  • How can I tell if my site is visible? Red eye = site is hidden from search engines; Green eye = site is visible.
  • Can I support the plugin development? Yes, via Ko-fi or Buy Me a Coffee.
